brief.subject: EUDR: JRC forest map Version 4 and November IS training
brief.headline: JRC Releases Version 4 of 2020 Global Forest Cover Map; EUDR System Training Set for November
brief.dek: The Commission publishes a new 2020 forest cover map version and announces November training dates for the EUDR Information System.
brief.lede: The EU's Joint Research Centre has released Version 4 of its Global Forest Cover map for 2020, a reference layer many EUDR teams use when checking plot locations.

sections.heading: New 2020 Forest Map Version
bullets: The JRC released Version 4 of its Global Forest Cover map for 2020, published by the Commission on 2026-10-19.
Teams that screen plot geolocation against this map should confirm which version their tools and suppliers currently use.
Results from earlier versions may differ, so past risk checks could need a fresh look.

sections.heading: November Information System Training
bullets: The Commission has announced November training dates for the EUDR Information System.
Staff who file due-diligence statements can use the sessions to learn the system before submissions pile up.
Check the Commission's environment newsroom for the session schedule and details.
